The '''Bheriz system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bheriz]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bherizian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
